author: mamamamo
quote:
This generation of GTA is not GTA at all—it’s basically a modern-day RDR2. The official side claims players have free choice, but if you choose to commit crimes like in previous GTAs, you’re hit with a ton of punishment systems. The worst part is they even package these punishments as “realism.” What the ****?

On top of that, the female protagonist’s character design is just annoying. The way the relationship is handled is completely anti-human. If you try to refuse interacting with her, you lose a huge chunk of the story content. And the game doesn’t even let you choose another partner—it just piles on punishment mechanics to force players to follow the official route. This is a completely disgusting approach.
